destination.title: Gravitational-wave sources, cosmic history and detection
destination.question: How can gravitational-wave production, propagation and measurement reveal astrophysical systems, cosmic history and fundamental physics?
destination.summary: This is a proposed navigation scope, not a single physical question. No original verbal region scope was supplied. The numerical collection is scientifically useful after separating the disc-chemistry source and retaining the compound ALP/cloud source with explicit branch distinctions.

systems: Cosmic strings, primordial plasmas and perturbations
Axion–gauge fields, boson clouds and proposed graviton detectors
targets: Waveforms, backgrounds, spectral features and source discrimination
Observational evidence, forecasts and physical detection limits
regimes: Later astrophysical evolution and dark-energy dynamics
Source-specific frequency bands and dimensional settings
assumptions: Each source retains its own cosmology, production mechanism and observational assumptions.
Forecasts, programme objectives and model examples do not establish detections or universal viability.
conventions: Historical normalization and detector assumptions remain dated.
Broad-card membership does not establish fine-question equivalence.
includes: CMB, pulsar-timing, interferometric and laboratory approaches
Comparative access to nongravitational signatures when explicitly identified
excludes: Disc shock chemistry as a gravitational-wave question
Identification of ALP matter-power signatures with string-generated gravitational waves
Treating extracted graph relations as independently verified physical premises

sources.title: Laser Interferometer Space Antenna

evidence.text: How do massive black holes form, grow and assemble across cosmic history, and what is the nature of gravity near their horizons and on cosmological scales? The proposed low-frequency GW observatory also targets compact-binary evolution and early-Universe physics.

sources.title: The NANOGrav Program for Gravitational Waves and Fundamental Physics

evidence.text: How should NANOGrav's pulsar-timing program detect and characterize nanohertz gravitational waves, resolve individual supermassive black-hole binaries, and extend fundamental-physics tests? This is an Astro2020 program white paper presenting a 2019 roadmap.

sources.title: Science Case for the Einstein Telescope

evidence.text: What astrophysics, strong-field gravity, dark-sector physics and early-Universe science could the proposed Einstein Telescope enable through cosmological gravitational-wave observations, alone and with other observatories?

sources.title: BSM with Cosmic Strings: Heavy, up to EeV mass, Unstable Particles

evidence.text: Can a measured cosmic-string stochastic gravitational-wave background constrain the lifetime and abundance of heavy unstable particles that temporarily dominated the pre-BBN universe, and thereby probe their production mechanisms and couplings?

sources.title: Gravitational Waves as a Big Bang Thermometer

evidence.text: Can gravitational waves emitted by the primordial thermal plasma reveal its maximum temperature and entropy degrees of freedom, and what cosmological constraints or laboratory techniques could access this background?

sources.title: Probing Primordial Features with the Stochastic Gravitational Wave Background

evidence.text: Can amplified primordial features produce a scalar-induced stochastic gravitational wave background detectable by space interferometers, especially LISA, while retaining spectral information about inflationary dynamics? Can reconstruction or analytical templates distinguish the resulting feature classes?

sources.title: The NANOGrav 15 yr Data Set: Search for Signals from New Physics

evidence.text: Which cosmological models can reproduce the NG15 gravitational-wave background, how do they compare with an SMBHB benchmark, and which new-physics parameters can pulsar timing constrain independently of the background's origin?

sources.title: Topics in the phenomenology of axions: the cases of cosmic strings and superradiance

evidence.text: What matter-power signature arises from ultralight ALPs emitted by global cosmic strings, and what gravitational-wave signal arises directly from tidally driven transitions of a superradiant boson cloud in a black-hole binary?

sources.title: Gravitational wave bursts from cosmic (super)strings: Quantitative analysis and constraints

evidence.text: How should interferometer searches detect cosmic-string cusp bursts, estimate realistic event rates for arbitrary loop distributions, and translate a nondetection into model-dependent parameter constraints?

sources.title: Laser Interferometer Space Antenna

evidence.text: Science objectives are translated into observational thresholds and mission requirements using frequency-domain SNR estimates, instrument-noise transfer functions, sky/polarisation-averaged GW response, and Fisher Information Matrix parameter forecasts.

sources.title: The NANOGrav Program for Gravitational Waves and Fundamental Physics

evidence.text: Bayesian background searches compare common red-noise models with and without quadrupolar correlations through Bayes factors. Frequentist cross-correlation estimators fit the Hellings–Downs curve; a hybrid Bayesian–frequentist statistic is also used. Searches include stochastic, continuous-wave and burst signals.

sources.title: Science Case for the Einstein Telescope

evidence.text: Black-hole spectroscopy compares at least three independent quasi-normal-mode frequencies or damping times against the two remnant parameters, mass and spin; extensions include parametrized beyond-Kerr deviations.

sources.title: BSM with Cosmic Strings: Heavy, up to EeV mass, Unstable Particles

evidence.text: Determine loop-formation efficiency with the velocity-dependent one-scale model, using mean velocity and correlation length. The reported transient response to changing cosmology makes instantaneous scaling overestimate the matter-to-radiation turning-point frequency by more than one order of magnitude.

sources.title: Gravitational Waves as a Big Bang Thermometer

evidence.text: The sourced GW evolution equation is integrated after normalizing the energy density by s^(4/3). Entropy conservation, momentum redshifting and temperature-dependent energy, entropy and heat-capacity degrees of freedom determine the present spectrum.

sources.title: Probing Primordial Features with the Stochastic Gravitational Wave Background

evidence.text: Compute induced GW energy density from the radiation-era convolution of two scalar power spectra, using the standard radiation transfer function and Ωr,0≈8.6×10^-5. Fit observationally relevant spectral regions with piecewise analytical functions, matching their amplitudes across domains.

sources.title: Gravitational radiation from cosmic (super)strings: Bursts, stochastic background, and observational windows

evidence.text: How do reduced string reconnection probability p and uncertain newly formed loop size ε affect cusp-generated gravitational-wave bursts, the stochastic background, and interferometer versus pulsar-timing observational windows?

sources.title: Graviton-photon oscillations as a probe of quantum gravity

evidence.text: Can a Gertsenshtein detector reliably detect one incident graviton by converting it into a detectable photon, once electromagnetic vacuum polarization and cosmological expansion are included?

sources.title: Challenges and opportunities of gravitational-wave searches at MHz to GHz frequencies

evidence.text: Which sources motivate MHz–GHz gravitational-wave searches, how should their signals be compared with detector sensitivities, and what technological obstacles limit detection?

sources.title: Revisiting string-inspired running-vacuum models under the lens of light primordial black holes

evidence.text: Can gravitational waves induced by light-PBH density fluctuations constrain logarithmic-curvature corrections in string-inspired running-vacuum models, and can corrections derived around de Sitter backgrounds consistently describe a PBH-driven early matter era?

sources.title: Testing BSM physics with gravitational waves

evidence.text: How robust is the thermal Cosmic Gravitational Wave Background against general weakly coupled BSM sectors, and can entropy injection or a post-reheating stiff era alter its peak enough to diagnose new physics or constrain early cosmology?

sources.title: What would we learn by detecting a gravitational wave signal in the cosmic microwave background anisotropy?

evidence.text: What would detecting inflationary gravitational waves in CMB anisotropy imply for the inflaton field excursion, potential height, and compatibility with particle-physics models?

sources.title: Generic 3-point statistics with tensor modes in light of Swampland and Trans-Planckian Censorship Conjecture

evidence.text: Which adopted quantum-gravity restrictions obstruct detectable vacuum-generated primordial gravitational waves? The source reviews a steep-potential criterion and TCC, then invokes a refined curvature branch to accommodate a small first slow-roll parameter.

sources.title: The NANOGrav 12.5 yr Data Set: Search for an Isotropic Stochastic Gravitational-wave Background

evidence.text: Does the NANOGrav 12.5-year data set support an isotropic stochastic gravitational-wave background, including the Hellings–Downs spatial correlations needed to distinguish a GR-compatible background from a common red spectrum and clock or ephemeris systematics?

sources.title: Gravitational wave bursts from cusps and kinks on cosmic strings

evidence.text: What waveforms, amplitudes, beaming patterns, and occurrence rates arise from cosmic-string cusps and kinks, and how does their non-Gaussian burst population alter detector prospects and pulsar-timing constraints?

sources.title: Primordial black holes and their gravitational-wave signatures

evidence.text: How do PBH formation, evolution, clustering and binary formation determine gravitational-wave signatures, distinguish primordial from stellar black holes, and enable detection with LISA?

sources.title: Gravitational wave landscape of cosmic string networks with varying tension

evidence.text: How does moduli-driven variation of cosmic-string tension change stochastic gravitational-wave spectral indices, and what conditional restrictions follow from Swampland conjectures?

sources.title: Species Scale and Primordial Gravitational Waves

evidence.text: Can a detection of inflationary primordial gravitational waves constrain the logarithmic decay rate of the field-dependent species cutoff, and how does the constraint depend on the inflationary model?

sources.title: Future targets for light gauge bosons from cosmic strings

evidence.text: How does simultaneous massive-vector and gravitational-wave emission from Abelian Higgs cosmic strings shape the stochastic GW spectrum, and which vector masses and symmetry-breaking scales are compatible with cosmology and accessible to forecast GW experiments?

sources.title: Matters of Gravity, The Newsletter of the Division of Gravitational Physics of the American Physical Society, Volume 50, December 2017

evidence.text: The proposed gravitational-wave town hall asks which theoretical models and simulations would best exploit anticipated O3/O4 detections, including merger remnants, neutron-star equations of state, spins and tests of general relativity.

sources.title: Kinks, extra dimensions, and gravitational waves

evidence.text: How does motion in internal dimensions change the waveform, angular geometry and cosmological rate of gravitational-wave bursts from cosmic-string kinks, and what does that imply for their prospective detectability?

sources.title: Superluminal Gravitational Waves

evidence.text: Can graviton vacuum polarization in curved spacetime provide a dynamical origin for very large early-universe gravitational-wave speeds, thereby stretching primordial tensor wavelengths to super-horizon scales?

sources.title: The effect of extra dimensions on gravity wave bursts from cosmic string cusps

evidence.text: How do motion in extra dimensions, cusp rounding and reduced cusp probability change gravitational-wave burst waveforms and event rates from cosmic-string networks, after accounting for reduced reconnection probability?

sources.title: Resonant features in the stochastic gravitational wave background

evidence.text: How do resonant, log(k)-periodic features in an enhanced primordial scalar power spectrum appear in the post-inflationary scalar-induced gravitational wave background, and what scalar-spectrum information could their modulations reveal?

sources.title: Gravitational wave bursts from cosmic strings

evidence.text: Do cosmic-string cusps generate individually distinguishable gravitational-wave bursts, what are their waveform and amplitude–rate relations, and could the then-planned LIGO/VIRGO and LISA detectors observe them?

sources.title: Detecting primordial features with LISA

evidence.text: Can LISA reconstruct oscillatory features in scalar-induced stochastic gravitational waves, and which signal parameters permit accurate measurements? The study distinguishes sharp versus resonant features and inflationary versus post-inflationary production.

sources.title: Gravitational Wave Signatures from Warm Dark Energy

evidence.text: Could CMB spectral distortions reveal low-frequency gravitational waves produced by late-time axion–gauge quintessence?

sources.title: Using gravitational waves to see the first second of the Universe

evidence.text: Which primordial processes could produce detectable stochastic gravitational wave backgrounds, and how could their spectra reveal particle physics and cosmic evolution between inflation and Big Bang nucleosynthesis?

sources.title: Is the NANOGrav signal a hint of dS decay during inflation?

evidence.text: The observational input is whether the NANOGrav 12.5-year common-spectrum process can be interpreted as a gravitational-wave background near inverse-year frequencies.

sources.title: The maximal frequency of cosmic gravitons

evidence.text: What is the largest present frequency of cosmic gravitons generated by early space-time curvature variation, and what does it imply for detection sensitivity and correlation measurements?

sources.title: Primordial black holes and associated gravitational waves in axion monodromy inflation

evidence.text: Can periodic modulations and gauge-particle production in axion monodromy inflation generate primordial black holes of astrophysical interest while preserving the paper's historical CMB constraints, and what gravitational-wave signals accompany the selected examples?

destination.title: Flux, condensation and brane consistency in moduli physics
destination.question: How do fluxes, nonperturbative sectors and brane dynamics affect moduli stabilization, vacuum proposals and associated effective couplings?
destination.summary: The original proposal supplies numerical memberships without an explicit scientific boundary. Its strongest core concerns condensate backreaction, admissible nonperturbative sectors and stabilization compatibility. Gauge observables, inflation, statistical control and stabilization without nonperturbative effects provide useful adjacent questions. Neither common vocabulary nor numerical proximity establishes fine identity.

sources.title: D-brane non-perturbative effects and geometric deformations

evidence.text: How does D-brane gaugino condensation modify ten-dimensional supersymmetry and geometry, and how can generalized-complex and three-form-flux descriptions explain the induced D3-brane superpotential?

sources.title: On brane gaugino condensates in 10d

evidence.text: Apply the localized-source prescription to D7 gaugino zero modes coupled to the type IIB complex three-form, tracking the coupling and volume dependence needed for a supergravity comparison.

sources.title: dS Vacua and the Swampland

evidence.text: Does a quadratic single-brane flux coupling determine the quartic fermion terms needed to analyze gaugino-condensate backreaction?

sources.title: Moduli axions, stabilizing moduli, and the large field swampland conjecture in heterotic M-theory

evidence.text: Can flux, gaugino condensation, worldsheet instantons and an anomalous-U(1) D-term stabilize heterotic M-theory moduli with negative, zero or positive vacuum energy while satisfying an asymptotic large-field Swampland gradient bound?

sources.title: On D3-brane Potentials in Compactifications with Fluxes and Wrapped D-branes

evidence.text: Compute the D3-position-dependent prefactor A(X) in the volume-stabilizing nonperturbative superpotential, determine its contribution to the D3 potential, and address the apparent nonholomorphy of wrapped-D7 gauge couplings.

sources.title: Flux Stabilization in 6 Dimensions: D-terms and Loop Corrections

evidence.text: Can gauge-flux D-terms consistently coexist with gaugino condensation and stabilize the dilaton and compactification volume of 6d supergravity? Can these ingredients provide an uplift, and how do charged-matter loops and R-symmetry twists affect the result?

sources.title: D-brane non-perturbative effects and geometric deformations

evidence.text: Compatible generalized pure spinors encode the geometry. A holomorphic Poisson bivector implements Z = Ω + θ with ιβΩ = θ. Locally, Poincaré–Lelong gives θ = −(ℓs^4/π)∂w and w = ⟨S⟩log h + w0, where h defines the condensing divisor.

sources.title: On brane gaugino condensates in 10d

evidence.text: Track measure, inverse-metric and spinor-derivative powers through reduction and field substitution. Distinguish the Kähler-independent form from the volume-normalized form before comparing the gaugino interaction coefficients.

sources.title: dS Vacua and the Swampland

evidence.text: Replace the squared holomorphic coefficient by a strictly positive real function while retaining the normalized linear S superpotential. Compare the resulting bosonic potential with the original model at small beta.

sources.title: Moduli axions, stabilizing moduli, and the large field swampland conjecture in heterotic M-theory

evidence.text: Diagonalize scalar kinetic and mass terms, restrict the retained potential to the D-flat direction, approximately minimize its axion cosines, and use Mathematica for numerical extrema and fluctuation masses.

sources.title: On D3-brane Potentials in Compactifications with Fluxes and Wrapped D-branes

evidence.text: Expand Green's functions in normalized angular harmonics and radial modes. Wrapped-cycle integrals impose angular selection rules; Jacobi-polynomial identities and integration by parts establish cancellations. AdS/CFT identifies the surviving contributions with chiral and antichiral operators.

sources.title: Flux Stabilization in 6 Dimensions: D-terms and Loop Corrections

evidence.text: Dimensional reduction and Weyl rescaling determine the 4d Kähler potential and gauge kinetic function. The authors compare direct integration of the flux energy with the supergravity D-term obtained from the modulus Killing vector.

sources.title: De Sitter vacua from heterotic M theory

evidence.text: Can open membrane instantons and hidden-boundary gaugino condensation generate positive-energy, supersymmetry-breaking vacua while stabilizing the orbifold length and charged matter in heterotic M-theory?

sources.title: On flux compactification and moduli stabilization

evidence.text: Can charged matter and gauge fluxes on D3/D7 branes stabilize the dilaton and real Kähler modulus in non-SUSY Minkowski or de Sitter vacua without nonperturbative effects, both with the dilaton integrated out and retained?

sources.title: A Barren landscape?

evidence.text: What necessary conditions govern nonperturbative superpotentials in warped F-theory flux compactifications, and do abelian instantons or gaugino condensation stabilize the remaining volume modulus?

sources.title: Four-modulus 'Swiss Cheese' chiral models

evidence.text: Can explicit four-Kähler-modulus compactifications combine LVS stabilization with chirally intersecting D7 stacks and a neutral E3 superpotential, while respecting Freed–Witten flux quantization and Kähler-cone constraints?

sources.title: Gaugino condensation and nonperturbative superpotentials in flux compactifications

evidence.text: Can flux stabilize coincident D7 branes at enhanced gauge symmetry while lifting their matter, thereby generating a gaugino-condensation superpotential for Kähler moduli? How does this affect arithmetic-genus restrictions and proposals with a single Kähler modulus?

sources.title: Moduli Stabilisation for Chiral Global Models

evidence.text: Can globally consistent chiral D7-brane constructions coexist with controlled Kähler moduli stabilisation, avoiding chirality obstructions to nonperturbative effects, Freed–Witten anomalies and D-term-induced divisor collapse?

sources.title: Obstacles to Constructing de Sitter Space in String Theory

evidence.text: Can statistical tuning supply control when simple flux-scaling balances fail? The reviewed proposal uses rare small superpotentials in a large ensemble, a prospective parameter distinct from making all fluxes large.

sources.title: Heterotic string theory on nonKahler manifolds with H flux and gaugino condensate

evidence.text: Can the heterotic H-flux balance against non-Kähler geometry be combined with the flux/gaugino-condensate balance to obtain supersymmetry-breaking vacua with zero cosmological constant, and what effective superpotential would describe them?

sources.title: Moduli stabilization in (string) model building: Gauge fluxes and loops

evidence.text: Can gauge-flux D-terms, a Scherk-Schwarz source for a constant superpotential, and gaugino condensation consistently stabilize the dilaton and volume moduli, and do flux-induced quantum corrections preserve the resulting minimum?

sources.title: Moduli Stabilisation versus Chirality for MSSM like Type IIB Orientifolds

evidence.text: Can an unbroken chiral MSSM-like D7-brane sector coexist with flux and nonperturbative moduli stabilization, especially in the large-volume scenario, once charged instanton zero modes and D-terms are included?

sources.title: Stabilizing moduli with thermal matter and nonperturbative effects

evidence.text: Can gaugino-condensation stabilization of the dilaton coexist with radion stabilization by enhanced-symmetry momentum/winding strings, without their combined dynamics destabilizing either modulus? The paper presents a preliminary answer under simplifying approximations.

sources.title: Gaugino condensation and SUSY breakdown

evidence.text: How can hidden-sector gaugino condensation, together with higher-dimensional antisymmetric-tensor flux, produce four-dimensional supersymmetry breaking, control vacuum energy, and contribute to moduli stabilization?

sources.title: Flux Compactifications, dS Vacua and the Swampland

evidence.text: How can an anti-D3-brane multiplet description transform consistently under axio-dilaton modular transformations? The appendix treats τ and the background three-flux G3 as transforming objects and asks for compatible matter transformations and vector duality.

sources.title: Uplifting and Inflation with D3 Branes

evidence.text: How do D3/D7 back-reaction, nonperturbative modulus stabilization and supersymmetry-breaking D7 fluxes modify mobile-D3 forces, prospects for slow-roll inflation, and uplifting without anti-D3 branes?

sources.title: Bare-bones de Sitter vacua

evidence.text: Can anti-D3 branes supply both the uplift and the small superpotential needed for Kähler-modulus stabilization, allowing de Sitter minima without an independently introduced supersymmetry-breaking flux superpotential?

sources.title: On D3-brane Superpotential

evidence.text: How does a mobile D3-brane enter the D7 gaugino-condensation superpotential, and how can its divisor-section description encode the complex-structure dependence visible in flat-coordinate calculations?

sources.title: $ \overline{\textrm{D}3} $-branes and gaugino condensation

evidence.text: Do supersymmetry-breaking fluxes sourced by anti-D3 branes in a warped Klebanov–Strassler throat generate D7 gaugino masses large enough to invalidate Kähler-moduli stabilization by gaugino condensation?

sources.title: Towards an Explicit Model of D-brane Inflation

evidence.text: Can induced D7 magnetic fields change the D3 potential or its nonperturbative gauge-coupling dependence? The calculation combines a supersymmetric holomorphic D7 with a leading warp-factor perturbation.

sources.title: Supersymmetry breaking and determination of the unification gauge coupling constant in string theories

evidence.text: Can modular-invariant hidden-sector gaugino condensation dynamically fix the dilaton at a realistic gauge coupling while generating hierarchical supersymmetry breaking, and how do matter, multiple condensates and Green–Schwarz terms affect this?

sources.title: Heterotic moduli stabilization with fractional Chern-Simons invariants

evidence.text: Can small fractional H-flux induced by Wilson lines balance hidden-sector gaugino condensation to stabilize heterotic dilaton, complex-structure and Kähler moduli at weak coupling and large radius?

sources.title: Moduli stabilisation and de Sitter string vacua from magnetised D7 branes

evidence.text: How do magnetised D7 branes, charged matter and anomalous U(1) symmetries modify Kähler-modulus stabilisation, and under which charge and geometric conditions can they lift nonsupersymmetric AdS minima to de Sitter?

sources.title: Gaugino Condensates and D-terms from D7-branes

evidence.text: Can flux-induced D-terms on one D7 stack coexist consistently with a Kähler-modulus-dependent gaugino-condensation superpotential on a different stack, as required by proposed D-term uplifts?

sources.title: On brane gaugino condensates in 10d

evidence.text: Determine whether localized gaugino condensation admits a finite ten-dimensional flux description consistent with four-dimensional supergravity. The issue matters for moduli stabilization and positivity arguments sensitive to localized brane contributions.

sources.title: Completing the D7-brane local gaugino action

evidence.text: Can the divergent quartic gaugino interaction generated by integrating out bulk three-form flux near D7-branes be renormalized using a local, covariant brane action that reduces to the expected 4d N=1 supergravity gaugino couplings?

sources.title: Non-supersymmetric String Models from Anti-D3-/D7-branes in Strongly Warped Throats

evidence.text: How can intersecting anti-D3-/D7-branes supply matter and uplift energy within a low-energy supergravity description, and how do warping and closed-string moduli stabilisation determine their masses and couplings?
